cluster.description: Cluster name, exactly as returned by list_clusters.

end.description: Range end, same forms as start. Defaults to now.

label.description: Label name whose values to list, e.g. "job" or "namespace". Use "__name__" for metric names.

matchers.description: Optional series selectors scoping the lookup.

pattern.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter applied to the values at the hub.

start.description: Range start. Relative ("now-1h") or RFC 3339. Defaults to now-1h.
